body: Gated simplification: delete the legacy Sense->Sharpen path (classify_sense_sharpen_inner + its ~300-line inline header cascade, wire_sense/set_sense, the char-cnn/tiered/transformer ModelType loaders, and models/char-cnn-v7|tiered-v1|sibling-context). NOT dead code -- it is the live path for --model-type char-cnn|tiered|transformer + a wired Sense model; the default (m2v8m-s43) and v19 are both multi-branch and do NOT use it. Removal reverses the settled 'Original Sense implementation remains in code as an alternative' decision, so it needs a choice record + card-0019-scenario-5 no-regression gold run, NOT a refactor. Surface: ~700 lines in classify_sense_sharpen_inner, 29 non-test loader refs, 14 refs in tests.rs + 9 in main.rs. BLOCKED ON t-0001080618 (public-release wants to ADD download/restore for exactly these legacy models -- settle that direction first). Hazard meanwhile: its inline header cascade is a DIVERGENT duplicate of apply_header_sharpen (thresholds 0.85/0.5 vs 0.95/0.85), so audit edits land only on the multi-branch copies. Surfaced in spec 2026-06-25-sharpen-stage-audit ac-0.

ac-1 url-cluster fix: 5 attention breaks (link_id x2, episode_url_id, link_description, remove_compare_link) where a 'link'/'url' header_hint promotes non-url values to technology.internet.url. The validator-corroboration guard CANNOT do this: the url universal validator rejects genuine urls too (href, gold=url, passes ~0% -- the protocol-relative // gap, task t-00007f4d). Fix: extend url_bare_number_veto to also demote url->alphanumeric_id/text when values are non-url-shaped (no '://'), independent of the validator; OR fix the url validator // gap first then the scoped guard can include url. Gold no-regression + corpus-honest. Evidence: output/sharpen-audit/ac1_measurement.md.

ac-1 utc-cluster fix: 4 attention breaks (utc_offset x4, gold=decimal) where 'utc offset' header_hint promotes millisecond-integer columns (28800000.0) to datetime.offset.utc. Validator guard can't gate (utc validator rejects ms-integers AND a gold=utc sibling at ~0%). Fix: dedicated utc_offset bare-number/ms demotion (ms-integers -> decimal_number). NOTE the 5th utc_offset (sha e2695df2e762, gold=offset.utc) has the SAME ms encoding as the 4 gold=decimal ones -> ac-3 gold inconsistency to resolve. Evidence: output/sharpen-audit/ac1_measurement.md.

ac-1 ordinal + alphanumeric_id clusters: (a) Grade/GlobalRank/TldRank/Region Rank -- deprecated header_hint 'rank'/'grade' arm promotes plain numerics to discrete.ordinal (no/loose validator); tighten the arm or value-gate ordinal to small bounded rank sets. (b) ipni_id x2, coord_id -- alphanumeric_id validator rejects digit+separator ids (69732-1, 15_77227420) so the profile validation veto hard-rejects to unknown; widen the alphanumeric_id validator OR keep alphanumeric_id on veto rather than demote-to-unknown. Both gold-gated. Evidence: output/sharpen-audit/ac1_measurement.md.

SCOPE EXPANDED + UNBLOCKED (author 2026-06-25). README declares Early Release (breaking changes to taxonomy/CLI/APIs/model formats expected between releases), so the t-0001080618 blocker is OBVIATED: DELETE the abandoned model paths rather than add download/restore. Comprehensive dead-architecture removal: (1) LEGACY SENSE PATH (as above). (2) FUSION PATH: classify_fusion + fusion_cardinality_gate (mod.rs ~2300) + with_fusion/has_fusion + load_fusion_classifier + fusion_manifest auto-detect (value-fusion abandoned per CLAUDE.md). (3) MODEL-TYPE LOADERS: drop ModelType::{CharCnn,Tiered,Transformer} + loaders + legacy model dirs models/{char-cnn-v7,tiered-v1,sibling-context}. (4) CATEGORICAL-SENTINEL COLLAPSE (behaviour-neutral): once fusion is gone the only non-default consumer of representation.discrete.categorical (fusion_cardinality_gate) is dead, so the ~13 Sharpen producer sites (feature_sharpen F6, header_sharpen arms, value_sharpen R32/schema_fail_demotion/select_fallback) emit representation.text.word DIRECTLY, then delete enum_reframe_residual + CATEGORICAL_LABEL sentinel. Behaviour-equivalent on multi-branch (categorical->word either way; both already generic-residual) so MUST be 0 gold delta. GATING: gold no-regression + green CI; do fusion removal BEFORE the categorical collapse. Evidence: 2026-06-25 guard-ablation finding (enum_reframe -47 proves the reframe is load-bearing UNTIL producers are rewired).

RELEASE: cut binary release 0.6.37. READY — model unchanged (m2v8m-s43, so NO model release / promotion gates), CHANGELOG [Unreleased] complete (header-hint ordinal/name retirement, header_hint_value_corroboration, url over-emit + // validator fix, h3 R32 scope, datetime.offset.timezone_abbreviation; bundles the already-staged datapackage/frictionless work). All gates green (finetype check, full workspace tests, clippy), tree pushed. Ships +1.5pp on the shipped default. Run /release binary (deliberate network action: bumps 0.6.36->0.6.37, tags, triggers GitHub release workflow + Homebrew tap). Pre-flight: no duckdb pin bump so the MSVC/amalgamation risk does not apply. Read docs/RELEASE.md binary-release section first.

ATTENTION-MODEL CO-SHIP DECISION (sharpen-audit ac-4 follow-through). The audit demonstrated the ceiling-break: attention model (m2v8m-attn) + cleaned Sharpen composes 0.817 gold vs the 0.794 rule-bound baseline (+2.3pp). Decide whether to PROMOTE m2v8m-attn as the default. This IS a model release (HF upload + FINETYPE_CI_MODEL bump + models/default flip, per docs/RELEASE.md promotion flow) and clears the model-promotion gates (gold + the gold-adjudicated relocation review, choice 0104 — corpus-honest is structurally unpassable by a model swap). Separate from the 0.6.37 binary release; could ship together or after. Refs spec 2026-06-23-dual-encoder-native-ship-potion8m, memory composed-is-rule-bound.

PERF (card 0006-command-line-interface): skip sibling-context attention for single-value/single-column infer. cmd_infer (main.rs ~900/908) unconditionally wires sibling-context attention (396800 params, cross-column) even for 'infer -i <one value> --mode column', where it is useless (no siblings to attend). Measured: --mode column 0.13s vs --mode row 0.02s warm; cold ~1s (model page-in). FIX: only wire sibling-context when there are >=2 columns to classify. Easy win, spark-joy/CLI-latency pillar. Note: --mode row already avoids it (the current fast path for single values).

PERF (card 0006-command-line-interface): deterministic fast-path for infer. A value a deterministic detector resolves with certainty (datetime_format e.g. '2024-01-15T14:30:00.123Z' -> iso_8601_milliseconds; structured_string windows_path/message_id/qualified_name; tz_abbrev; the closed-set validators) needs ZERO neural weights. FIX: in cmd_infer, try the value-based detectors BEFORE loading the multi-branch model; short-circuit and return on a confident deterministic match. Makes format-detectable infer near-instant regardless of --mode (currently the ~0.13s/cold-~1s is all model load, not inference). Pairs with the sibling-context skip.

RESOLVED 2026-06-25: (a) ordinal cluster DONE — the rank/grade->ordinal header-hint arm was retired (Grade/GlobalRank/TldRank/Region Rank recovered, +3 default). (b) alphanumeric_id cluster CLOSED as not-winnable — the over-emit diagnosis re-derived the 0096 residual-attractor NO-GO (veto_shape_fallback's cardinality gate is deliberate precision protection; broadening it is the swept P=0.63 NO-GO that steals url/uuid/address). Memory sharpen-header-hint-validator-corroboration. Closing.

DECISION 2026-06-25: DEFER, do not promote now. attn 0.817 vs shipped s43 0.812 is within CI (tie); the +3.9pp Sense lift is real but the model is single-seed + native-parity-unverified (ac-3 never ran on corpus). Primed candidate for the next model cut after a 3-seed best-of-3 + native parity + choice-0104 relocation review. Prioritising card-0006 latency work instead (attn adds +2.3ms/col). See memory attention-coship-no-swap.

DONE commit 91aac37. Removed the dead sibling-context load from infer (single + batch) via wire_model2vec_only — sibling-context is provably unreachable from the single-column classify path (only classify_columns_with_context uses it). Behaviour-preserving, 470+ tests green. HONEST FINDING: the predicted 'easy win' is only ~10ms — the sibling model is 1.5MB and loads fast. The real 0.11s --mode column cost is the multi-branch + 245-validator taxonomy load (batch load timer). The latency lever is t-…497e (deterministic fast-path). See memory infer-latency-breakdown.

DONE commit f150c34. finetype_core::fast_path::deterministic_fast_path: single-shot infer (no --header) resolves email/ip_v4/ip_v6/mac/windows_path/message_id/delimited-ISO-datetime from value-only validators before the model load. 0.12s->0.07s (~40%) on eligible values, ineligible unchanged. Conservative correct-by-construction set; agreement-tested vs full pipeline (never fires on non-members; only diffs are ip_v6/mac single values where fast-path is MORE correct). 9 unit tests + workspace clippy -D + 470 model/core/cli green. RHH kill-switch. See memory infer-deterministic-fast-path.

PROGRESS (branch dead-architecture-removal, pushed). DONE: choice 0107 (MADR + B07 audit); STAGE 1 fusion removal (fusion.rs, classify_fusion, with/has_fusion, ModelType::LateFusion + arms, load_fusion_classifier, dump-fusion-features cmd, train-fusion-head bin) - clippy-D/test/machete green; STAGE 2a legacy Sense->Sharpen removal (classify_sense_sharpen{,_inner,_with_context} incl the ~700-line divergent-duplicate inline header cascade, set_sense/has_sense, sense+label_map fields, load_sense/wire_sense, Sense embed in build.rs, extract-features dev bin, sense unit tests) - green. KEY AUDIT FINDING: models/sibling-context is NOT dead - the default multi-branch profile path wires it (profile.rs->wire_model2vec_and_siblings); deleting it is a behaviour change, EXCLUDED from this removal (choice 0107 carve-out). finetype-model sense.rs module KEPT (used by sibling-context training + label_category_map). REMAINING: (2b) ModelType::{CharCnn,Tiered,Transformer} + load_char/load_tiered + legacy classify_column path + models/{char-cnn-v7,tiered-v1} dirs - test-entangled (test_snapshot_flat/tiered_model load these). (3) categorical-sentinel collapse: rewire ~13 producers to emit word, delete enum_reframe_residual+CATEGORICAL_LABEL+validation_veto hook - BEHAVIOUR-SENSITIVE, MUST be 0 gold delta, needs the no-regression gold run (card 0019 scenario 5).

COMPLETE (branch dead-architecture-removal, 5 commits pushed). All 4 parts done + choice 0107. Stage 1 fusion, 2a legacy Sense (incl ~700-line divergent-duplicate inline cascade), 2b value-level architecture (ModelType + --model-type flag + CharCNN/Tiered/Transformer loaders + finetype train/eval subcommands + models/{char-cnn-v7,tiered-v1}; profile/infer now multi-branch-only; infer default mode row->column; /train skill updated), 3 categorical-sentinel collapse. PROVEN 0-delta on shipped default: gold 753/927=0.812 unchanged across stages, per-column prediction diff EXACTLY ZERO at each gold gate. clippy -D + cargo test + cargo machete green throughout. CARVE-OUT honored: sibling-context kept (default profile wires it). FOLLOW-UP filed: trim build.rs embed generation for the now-unused char/tiered/semantic/entity embeds (currently #[allow(dead_code)] on mod embedded; behaviour-neutral).

FOLLOW-UP (choice 0107 stage 2b): trim build.rs embed generation for the now-unused legacy embeds (FLAT_*/char-cnn, TIER_GRAPH/tiered, M2V_TYPE_EMBEDDINGS+M2V_LABEL_INDEX/semantic-hint, ENTITY_*+HAS_ENTITY_CLASSIFIER/entity-classifier). Their CLI loaders were removed; mod embedded is currently #[allow(dead_code)] as a stopgap. Remove the generate_* sections in crates/finetype-cli/build.rs (KEEP M2V_MODEL/M2V_TOKENIZER header encoder + MB_*/MB_VALUE_* multi-branch embeds), drop the models/entity-classifier embed if the MB model does not consume it, then remove the #[allow(dead_code)]. Behaviour-neutral; gold no-regression + green CI.

FOLLOW-UP (surfaced during embed-trim): the build.rs crates.io download fallback (download_models, HF_REPO=finetype-char-cnn, CACHE_VERSION=0.5.3) still downloads char-cnn-v11 as models/default + entity-classifier + sense. This predates the multi-branch default (m2v8m-s43) and is ALREADY wrong (downloads the wrong default); generate_embedded_models now panics on a non-multi-branch default, so a no-local-models crates.io install would fail at build. Point the download at the shipped multi-branch model's HF repo + files (MB model.safetensors/config.json/label_map.json + model2vec tokenizer/model + value_model2vec + sibling-context), drop the char-cnn/entity/sense/type_embeddings groups, bump CACHE_VERSION. Distribution/release concern; verify a clean cargo-install-from-crates.io build. Cross-check download-model.sh.

RESOLVED the utc-cluster gold inconsistency (commit ec117d0). 5th utc_offset (e2695df2, was gold=offset.utc) re-adjudicated to decimal — consistent with its 4 siblings. utc_bare_number_veto demotes bare-number/ms-float utc_offset over-emits. Composed gold 0.847->0.852, corpus-honest GO.
